mappings.note: Draws the structure of pentanal. Only a representation is asked for, so C 1.3-LO-4 alone; the name is supplied rather than tested, so not C 1.1-LO-4.
Draws the structure of ethanol. A representation task, so C 1.3-LO-4, not C 1.2-LO-8: no property or reaction of ethanol is asked.

Acetic acid with sodium hydrogencarbonate giving brisk effervescence - a chemical property of ethanoic acid, which LO-8 names. Not C 1.3: the item is about this named acid's behaviour, not about classifying an acid-base reaction.
Where ethanol is found in use (alcoholic drinks, syrups, tinctures). LO-8 is the only code naming ethanol; strictly it says 'properties', so uses sit at its edge.
Draws the simplest ketone. The drawing is C 1.3-LO-4, but the gate is knowing that a ketone needs a carbonyl on an inner carbon and therefore three carbons - a functional-group judgement, C 1.1-LO-4.
Reactants and catalyst of esterification - named verbatim in LO-8.

Name AND structure of a four-carbon aldehyde - duplicate of sha c2bd383c4839d1cc and mapped identically, since the two items are the same task.
